issues.description: The name getter for StockIngredient is named getIngredientName() in the TEMPLATE repository but getName() in the SOLUTION repository. Corresponding usages in Stock.findStockIngredient() also call these different getters. This is the same conceptual entity (the ingredient's name) but referenced with two different method names across artifacts, which can confuse students when mapping the problem requirement 'add getters for all the private fields' to the provided template and the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the getter name for the ingredient's name across template and solution. Prefer the standard Java getter name getName() (update the template's StockIngredient.getIngredientName() to getName() and adjust all call sites in Stock.findStockIngredient and other classes), or consistently use getIngredientName() in both repositories. Update related usages so the same identifier is used everywhere.
